mainEntity.name: How much does Answer Engine Optimization typically cost for a small business in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Answer Engine Optimization for a small business in Los Angeles varies significantly based on the scope of work, the current state of the business's online presence, and the competitiveness of the local market. Basic AEO services might include optimizing your Google Business Profile and implementing schema markup, while more comprehensive packages could involve extensive content creation for FAQs, voice search keyword research, and ongoing monitoring. Prices can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month, depending on whether you opt for a project-based fee or a monthly retainer for ongoing optimization and strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO costs for a small business in Los Angeles vary widely, from a few hundred to several thousand dollars monthly, depending on service scope and market competitiveness.
